default/32070.htm.text: Adolph: Get away! Get away from me! If I get caught by that old man Edwin, he'll kill me! Ha! There's nothing more fun than playing tricks on him, though! Hey, you're going to give me away! Get away from here if you don't have any business with me! I'm mental!
